title: First-Exit Time Analysis for Truncated Heavy-Tailed Dynamical Systems
summary: In this paper, we study the first-exit time of stochastic difference equation $X^η_{j+1}(x) = X^η_{j}(x) + ηa\big( X^η_{j}(x)\big) + ησ\big( X^η_{j}(x)\big)Z_{j+1}$ and its truncated variant $X^{η|b}_{j+1}(x) = X^{η|b}_{j}( x) + \varphi_b\big(ηa\big( X^{η|b}_{j}( x)\big) + ησ\big( X^{η|b}_{j}( x)\big) Z_{j+1}\big)$, where $\varphi_b(x) = (x/|x|)\min\{|x|, b\}$ and the law of the noise $Z_t$ is multivariate regularly varying.
